answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25588 Country: India Title: I want to know the which tasbeeh has to be recited in the taraveeh? Question: Assalam Alai Kum Mutfi sab I want to know the which tasbeeh has to be recited in the taraveeh Answer ID: 25588 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1519/1139/D=1431) You can recite durood, third kalimah or any other zikr in tarwiha, and if you remain silent then too there is no harm. No fixed tasbih is proved from hadith for this particular break. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
